name: Physical Grammar Hypothesis
notes: Umbrella speculative hypothesis family; not an accepted physical framework.

name: Weak PGH
notes: After prior-art subtraction, too broad to function as a discriminating scientific target; retained for historical taxonomy only.

name: Strong PGH
notes: Retained as umbrella formulation; active scientific work is routed through the prior-art-subtracted residual target PGH-OBJ-0008.

name: Linguistic-Physical Identity Hypothesis
notes: Quarantined speculative extension; not operationalized and not an active sequencing target.

name: DISTINGUISH
notes: Superseded as independent primitive at bare formation well-formedness scope.

name: COMPOSE
notes: Superseded as a privileged binary primitive; only abstract generativity remains architecturally required.

name: IDENTIFY
notes: Superseded as independent primitive at bare well-formedness scope.

name: Residual Strong Physical Grammar Hypothesis
notes: Prior-art-subtracted working target with two necessary burdens: R1 physical-irrelevance selection and R2 law exhaustion. No novelty or physical-confirmation claim.

name: Context/Record Semantic Anchor Schema
notes: Formally feasible minimal semantic interface separating probe/record interpretation from grammar-generated response; conditional representation robustness is established, but physical privilege remains unestablished.

name: Law-Free Empirical Contact Signature
notes: Provisional semantic-reference schema: empirical probe/record designation without primitive response relation, distribution, or complete possibility set. Physical privilege and completeness remain unestablished.

name: Grammar-Generated Empirical Interface Closure Schema
notes: Provisional formal schema in which a law-free empirical seed is expanded by least closure under response-independent constructors inherited from the grammar formation skeleton; physical completeness and privilege remain unestablished.

name: DCI minimal grammar candidate
notes: Opening shell superseded by PGH-GRAM-0002.

name: Extensional Formation Baseline
notes: Provisional nonphysical baseline; remains active because no successor grammar has qualified.

name: Contextual Extensional Reduction
notes: Qualified formal result; prior-art adjudication classifies it as a local reformulation/specialization with no novelty weight.

name: Isomorphism Covariance Underdetermination
notes: Qualified formal result; no novelty weight.

name: Parse Coherence Implies Associativity
notes: Qualified conditional result; rediscovery/local specialization of established coherence theorem family.

name: Presentation Projection Factorization
notes: Qualified formal result; no novelty weight.

name: Coherence Monotonicity Under Forgetting
notes: Qualified formal result; finite 16/8/6/0 ladder retained as project-specific control.

name: Formal Equivalence Does Not Entail Physical Equivalence
notes: Qualified formal R1 result; a physical-significance restriction is required. No novelty claim.

name: Anchor/Response Separation
notes: Qualified formal result: one context/record anchor can support distinct evaluator response laws, so interface semantics need not encode the response table.

name: Anchor Translation Commutation
notes: Qualified conditional formal result: commuting evaluator and record translations preserve record profiles on the declared shared interface.

name: Least Grammar Interface Closure
notes: Qualified formal result: a unique least response-independent constructor closure exists, finite seeds can expand nontrivially, and fixed grammar extraction removes a separate closure oracle without establishing physical completeness.

name: Empirical Generator Closure Equivalence
notes: Qualified formal result: equal-closure seeds are equivalent for all downstream structure that factors through generated closure; full physical equivalence is not established.

name: Intrinsic Substructure Selector Symmetry Obstruction
notes: Qualified formal result: a unique automorphism-invariant selector can choose only a substructure fixed setwise by every grammar automorphism.

name: Bare Formation Grammar Physical Sufficiency Failure
notes: Preserved no-smuggling/universal-encoding control.

name: Strong Permutation Invariance as Label Neutrality Failure
notes: Preserved failure.

name: Unprivileged Simplicity Selection Failure
notes: Preserved negative control.

name: Unique Projection from Representation Invariance Failure
notes: Preserved R1 control.

name: Frozen Equivalence Families as a Complete Physical Selector Failure
notes: No frozen equivalence family supplies physical privilege by form alone.

name: Semantic Anchor Extremes
notes: Primitive target equivalence is circular, vocabulary-only is too weak, and full response/task tables smuggle substantive physics.

name: Representation Robustness as Physical Privilege Failure
notes: Fine and coarse record maps can both be representation robust while inducing different distinguishability partitions; robustness is not physical privilege.

name: Empirical Interface as Response Law Failure
notes: Primitive allowed-response relations, response distributions, or complete possibility sets smuggle substantive physical selection into semantics under strong PGH.

name: Arbitrary or Response-Sensitive Interface Closure
notes: Arbitrary closure operators and freely chosen constructor families universally encode target interfaces; response-sensitive closure imports substantive physics.

name: Unique or Minimal Empirical Seed
notes: Minimum generators can be nonunique and non-automorphism-related; inclusion-irredundant generators need not exist; target-defined seed optimization does not explain physical privilege.

name: Generic Empirical Substructure Privilege Selectors
notes: No tested general intrinsic selector avoids nonuniqueness, trivial extremes, or extra selector input; special asymmetric grammar uniqueness remains possible.
